_comment: Solar terms (24 节气) and festivals to fire calendar_event heartbeats on. solar_terms is keyed by full date (varies year-by-year — extend in your fork). festivals._yearly_solar is keyed by MM-DD (yearly). festivals._yearly_lunar is keyed by Chinese lunar date strings (resolved via zhdate).

solar_terms._comment: Example: 2026 dates for the eight major solar terms. Extend for other years; the room renderer also reads these for the season overlay (see room_mcp/config.season_terms).

festivals._comment: Add dates meaningful to you here. The 'special' field optionally routes a date to a distinct trigger label (e.g. 'event:my_birthday') with its own hint pool — see calendar_event_tick in scheduler.py for how that's used.
